notes:
Lead from inbound form; small engineering team (product + 2 backend devs). Primary goal: reduce per-chat cost for in-app support assistant that uses chat + embeddings for KB lookups. Customer is price-sensitive — runs ~8k user sessions/month, average session 25 messages. Key asks: 
- Token usage audit of current prompts and sample logs (asked for export).
- Recommendations: batching for background embedding/upsert jobs, prefix caching for repeated system prompts, prompt compression strategies (templating + slotting), using embeddings cache to avoid duplicate generation.
- Latency tolerance: p95 <= 400ms for reply generation; willing to trade some latency for cost in lower tier flows.
- Model preference: open to small/quantized variants; asked about Redwood model catalog and certified latency profiles.
- Security: needs SOC2 + audit logging; KMS for key material later.
- Quote from CTO: "We want predictable monthly spend — if you can show 30-40% savings with minimal UX impact we'll convert."
- UX note: prefer streaming responses but acceptable to buffer if batching yields savings for low-priority messages.
- Links: pricing deck: drive://redwood/pricing/thimble-optimus, security FAQ: drive://redwood/security/small-smb-faq.
- POC scope: 3-day hosted API POC focusing on: token-audit, prompt compaction, batching config for background jobs, embedding cache TTL recommendations.
- Sales tactic: PLG -> quick POC -> expand to Dedicated only if heavy sustained throughput/SLAs required.
